args:
set -e
MC="mc --config-dir /tmp/.mc"
$MC alias set v "http://minio.velero-backup.svc.cluster.local" \
    "$root_user" "$root_password"
# mc mirror does not create the destination when there is
# nothing to copy, so the first run needs this.
mkdir -p /nas/velero
# GUARD. --remove deletes anything on the NAS that is not in
# the bucket, so an empty or unreachable source would wipe the
# only off-Ceph copy we have. Refuse to run in that case.
src=$($MC ls v/velero/backups 2>/dev/null | grep -c . || true)
if [ "$src" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "REFUSING: source bucket lists no backups; not mirroring with --remove"
    exit 1
fi
echo "source has $src backup prefixes"
echo "=== mirroring velero bucket -> NAS ==="
# --overwrite --remove keeps the NAS an exact reflection, so
# Velero's own retention (ttl) drives what is kept here too.
$MC mirror --overwrite --remove v/velero /nas/velero
echo "=== result ==="
du -sh /nas/velero 2>/dev/null || echo "  (destination empty)"
df -h /nas | tail -1
date -u +"mirror completed %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" | tee /nas/LAST_MIRROR
containers.name: mirror

args:
set -euo pipefail
deadline=$(( $(date -u +%s) + 46800 ))   # 13h
while :; do
    busy=$(kubectl get backups.velero.io -A \
             -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.status.phase}{"\n"}{end}' 2>/dev/null \
           | grep -vE '^(Completed|PartiallyFailed|Failed|FailedValidation|Deleting)$' \
           | grep -c . || true)
    [ "$busy" -eq 0 ] && { echo "no backup in flight; proceeding"; break; }
    [ "$(date -u +%s)" -ge "$deadline" ] && {
        echo "TIMEOUT: $busy backup(s) still in flight after 13h; refusing to mirror a partial backup"
        exit 1
    }
    echo "waiting: $busy backup(s) still in flight"
    sleep 60
done
initContainers.name: wait-for-backups
